response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems engineer with strong software craftsmanship credentials, but his career has centered on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and D-lang work rather than Java/Kotlin enterprise development. There is no evidence of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or IDE internals experience, and Java appears only briefly as a secondary skill years ago, making him a weak match for this JVM-tooling-focused role.
strengths: Extensive, long-tenured senior/staff-level engineering experience across diverse domains
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, testing tools, workshops/talks)
Demonstrated ability to own complex systems end-to-end and work with low-level/performance-critical code (DLang, C/C++)
concerns: No demonstrated recent experience with Java or Kotlin at a professional level
No mention of Spring, Quarkus, Hibernate, or enterprise JVM frameworks
No evidence of IDE internals or language tooling experience, a core requirement

key_factors.factor: No IDE internals or language tooling background
Strong general software engineering seniority and craftsmanship
